title: 1970s parallel experiment model
statement: 1970s Gir/Mœbius parallel experiments formed multi-regime foundation; not a linear style evolution.
limitations: Cannot reproduce raw 1970s scans locally; La Déviation / Bandard Fou / Garage Hermétique use TEXT_ONLY_IN_P1

title: 1980s same-decade different-task variation
statement: Same decade / different project tasks produce different visual regimes; simple linear chronology insufficient.
limitations: catalog-renders identity SOURCE_IDENTIFIED only; image_match_status=PENDING for most 80s works

title: Stable Spatial Hand
statement: Cross-decade invariant: contour/silhouette control + spatial readability + physical legibility of strange forms.
limitations: Scale shift / deep staging are RESOURCES not invariants. Does not explain "why reading feels unstable".

title: Task-Conditioned Information Regime
statement: Information delivery dimensions (TEXT_AMOUNT, WORLD_EXPLANATION, EVENT_CAUSALITY, FUNCTIONAL_INFORMATION, VISUAL_AUTONOMY, PANEL_DENSITY) vary by task/project condition.
limitations: No dimensional coverage for tonal/register behavior

title: Strange Object Readability (5-axis framework)
statement: Function × Ontology × Physics × Human Relation × Space Role; relation can be legible before identity/ontology settles.
limitations: MACHINE_GATE only after OBJECT_GATE; no creatures / architecture without technical evidence

title: Relation First / Ontology Deferred (WORKING_MODEL_V0.1)
statement: Relations may become legible before identity/ontology becomes settled; Q1 default dominates, Q3 minority cases.
limitations: NOT upgraded to artist theory; CE-A/B/C definitions frozen before future reading

title: Crystal / Energy as project vocabulary
statement: Crystal is best treated as PROJECT VOCABULARY (Futurs Magiques 1983-84 + Cristal Saga 1986), not career-wide persistent motif.
limitations: Cristal Saga item-level local plate-front mapping EXHAUSTED; do not repair

title: Body as Narrative Resource
statement: Important events frequently happen to bodies first and are interpreted afterward. Three-volume recurrence in Cœur; partial replication outside.
limitations: 40 Days B does NOT meet threshold; FOURTH_LAYER_CANDIDATE_STATUS=NOT_READY_FOR_MODEL_PROMOTION; Phase 6B-R fresh-context replication is the NEXT gate

title: Counterexample: Stel vs 40 Days

limitations: Reviewer Blindness Caveat: PARTIAL_NOT_FULL; fresh-context replication needed for Master Model promotion
